summary: Restored the HIGH-5 bounded-join timeout in NativeProbeBackend::stop_probe. m9-61 had switched to inline handle.join() for stop-then-drain ordering but lost the 10s bound. Fix: spawn a waiter that joins the thread and signals via mpsc channel; recv_timeout on the caller's stack. If timeout elapses, warn and abandon the waiter (the MCP server response path must not block indefinitely). Closes the m9-61 follow-up.
title: 62 bounded stop probe HIGH-5 timeout

subject.issue: NativeProbeBackend::stop_probe joined the probe thread inline (no timeout) since m9-61; if the thread is wedged in waitpid (parent ignores SIGKILL), the MCP server blocks indefinitely
subject.fix: Restore the HIGH-5 pattern: spawn a waiter that joins + signals via mpsc; recv_timeout(10s) on caller's stack; abandon waiter on timeout
